result.topic_en: Attempts to sum alternating series of logarithmic terms such as l(1+x)/(1+x) - l(1+2x)/(1+2x) + ... by power-series expansion, with numerical checks of the coefficient sums of alternating series of powers of integers, and a crossed-out note that one method gave a false result.

methods.what: Expansion of the alternating series of l(1+nx)/(1+nx) in powers of x, using the alternating sums 1-1/2+1/3-...
Iterated differences of the alternating sequence of squares (Euler-type summation)
Defining xi as the series sum x/(1+x) - 2x/(1+2x) + ... and integrating it termwise
Power-series expansion of the alternating series l(1+nx)/n with termwise collection of coefficients
Iterated differences of the alternating sequence of cubes giving coefficients 1, -4, 1
Alternating series of logarithms of ratios
